evals.prompt: Create a custom map click buffer widget in VertiGIS Web SDK that listens to map click events, calculates a 100m buffer graphic using @arcgis/core, and displays the coordinates in an MUI Card using Typography and design tokens.
evals.expected_output: A production-ready VertiGIS Studio Web component decomposed into a Model (*Model.ts) and View (*.tsx), wrapped with LayoutElement, using MUI Typography and safe fallback design tokens.
expectations: Component model extends ComponentModelBase and uses @serializable decorators
React View wraps JSX inside LayoutElement imported from @vertigis/web/components
All textual elements use @mui/material Typography with variant and semantic color tokens, with zero raw HTML text elements
CSS custom properties include safe fallbacks (e.g., var(--primaryBackground, #ffffff))
ArcGIS class modules use default imports (e.g., import Graphic from '@arcgis/core/Graphic')

evals.prompt: Create a singleton background service that polls a REST API every 30 seconds and exposes an observable count to other components in VertiGIS Studio Web.
evals.expected_output: A TypeScript service extending ServiceBase with MobX observables, clean lifecycle hook cleanup, and entry point registration.
expectations: Timer and subscriptions initialized in _onInitialize() are cleanly disposed in _onDestroy()
Service is registered in src/index.ts using registry.registerService()

evals.prompt: Run initiate to inject VertiGIS Web SDK rules into AGENTS.md in an existing project repository.
evals.expected_output: Execution or recommendation of initiate_agents_md.py injecting directives between delimiting comments.
expectations: Directives are bounded by <!-- vertigis-web-sdk:start --> and <!-- vertigis-web-sdk:end -->

evals.prompt: Create a configurable alert banner widget in VertiGIS Web SDK that exposes title, auto-dismiss seconds, and alert severity (info, warning, error) as configurable properties in VertiGIS Studio Web Designer.
evals.expected_output: A complete VertiGIS Web component package implementing the Designer Settings Schema Protocol via getLayoutDesignerSettingsSchema, getLayoutDesignerSettings, and applyLayoutDesignerSettings on the component manifest, with LayoutElementProperties extending React props and live updateConfig() on the model.
expectations: React component props interface extends LayoutElementProperties<TModel>
Component manifest implements getLayoutDesignerSettingsSchema declaring field IDs, types (text, number, select), display names, and descriptions
Component manifest implements getLayoutDesignerSettings extracting XML attributes via args.node.attributes.get()
Component manifest implements applyLayoutDesignerSettings writing attributes back via args.node.attributes.set() and calling model.updateConfig()
Component model includes an updateConfig() method to update observable properties dynamically
